what: a tapered extrude of a profile in which an arc meets a line at a corner (a half disc)
method: positive taper grows the profile outward (as tests/oracle/05): at height z, d = z*tan3deg, the half disc R20 becomes the arc R'=20+d and the line moves to y=-d; area(z) = Int from y=-d to R' of 2*sqrt(R'^2-y^2) dy = R'^2*(pi/2+asin(d/R')) + d*sqrt(R'^2-d^2). V = Int area dz over z in 0..10 (Simpson) = 6555.91. Faces: top, bottom, flat wall, conical wall
